### US President Trump Meets Qatar PM at White House | WION News

US President Donald Trump said on Monday there was momentum toward ending the war with Iran, as he declared that the country "militarily, is effectively over," but kept open the possibility of new strikes.

Trump met at the White House with Qatar Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani -- a key mediator in the Iran war. It was his first meeting with a foreign leader since his party's massive losses in the midterm elections.

### Impeachment Hearing DAY 41 LIVE: 'Admit It...': Sara Duterte Trial In Philippines

The impeachment trial of Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte saw tense exchanges as senator-judges questioned a Davao City accountant over her testimony and the Vice President’s Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). Senator Lito Lapid asked witness Bajan whether she was being used, while Senator Raffy Tulfo pressed the defence on who prepared Duterte’s SALN. Defence lawyer Sison said the matter would be addressed at the appropriate time and indicated that Duterte’s testimony remained a possibility. The court adjourned the proceedings until November 11, when corporate counsel Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay is scheduled to testify.
